newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: ARA bunkers drift down, other areas firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: ARA bunkers drift down, other areas firm slightly.

text.p: ARA bunker prices drifted down on Friday, but other European bunker prices firmed modestly as light covering before the weekend gave a little life to the market, dealers said.
Rotterdam 380 cst bunkers began at $116 fob, but ended the day at $114 fob. Dealers said demand totalled 5,000-10,000 tonnes, with a small amount of covering before the weekend.
Most shipowners were prepared to wait for next week when a number of ships are due back in dock.
Hamburg bunkers were offered at $120 fob ARA, up $1/$2 from Thursday's close, but the market was very calm.
Mediterranean prices were mostly $1/$2 a tonne firmer, in some areas as a response to greater demand. Ports in Spain and France registered reasonable business, dealers said.
"We had quite a bit of emergency orders in the afternoon," said a supplier in Spain.
Fujairah prices held firm as Singapore bunkers gained and cargo prices were expected to rise further.
In Durban, supply returned to healthy levels after mid-week difficulties, and prices dropped accordingly.
